description: This file provides API service functions for a React frontend application, including functions to fetch and manipulate event data and weather information from a backend API. It exports several functions such as getEvents, createEvent, getCurrentWeather, and getForecast, which perform HTTP requests using the fetch API and normalize the backend responses.

methods.name: http(path, options = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP fetch request to a given path with options, handling JSON and text responses, and throws errors for non-OK responses.

methods.name: getEvents({ page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of events from the backend API with pagination and normalizes response data into an array.

methods.name: createEvent(payload)
methods.description: Creates a new event by sending a POST request with the provided payload to the backend API.

methods.name: getCurrentWeather({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {})
methods.description: Fetches current weather data from the backend proxy based on query parameters such as location and units.

methods.name: getForecast({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {})
methods.description: Fetches weather forecast data from the backend, normalizing different possible backend response shapes into a { daily: [...] } format.

ctags.name: getCurrentWeather
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getCurrentWeather({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: getForecast
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getForecast({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {}) {$/
